events.title: Release date update: we’re launching November 11th
events.summary: Hey Everyone! Small change of plans, our release date moves:from November 10th to November 11th, 2026. 🗓️Same platforms, same day one launch on Steam and XBOX, just one day later.Why the shift? Let’s just say it’s not random. Keep an eye on the Golden Joystick Awards in the coming days. 👀That’s all we can say for now.👉 Wishlist the game, play the demo and get ready for November 11th! events.title: The Sketchbook of Hope in the City: Where Thoughts Become Discoveries
events.summary: In this post, we’re exploring one of the defining features of Hope in the City—Hope’s Sketchbook, a space where thoughts, memories, and discoveries intertwine.
